A winner receives a certificate and medal from the Ministry of Education and a funded invitation to China for the ceremony and up to three months of academic research, and the stated purpose is to promote the dissemination of Chinese language and culture throughout the world.
official_frame_markers: dissemination of Chinese language and culture

anchor: English medical education standards the name list and the China course 2009
prompt: Who decides which Chinese universities may teach medicine in English to foreign students, and what must that curriculum include about China?
required_facts: The Ministry of Education commissions a Medical Education Expert Group to assess the teaching quality and to publish the name list of institutions and their scale of admission, and an institution not on that list may not enroll international students for the undergraduate medical program in English.

The curriculum must include Chinese culture and natural science courses, including an overview of China's culture, the Chinese language, and Chinese medical terminology, and students must pass the examinations in those courses.

anchor: English medical education standards matched to the Chinese program under a ministry list
prompt: Article 3 of the standards on English-language medical education for international students says the teaching plans shall match the training objectives and requirements of the undergraduate medical program for Chinese students, and that the basic requirements for international students shall also match those for Chinese students. Article 30 then has the Ministry of Education commission an expert group to publish the name list of institutions allowed to enroll, and bars any institution not on it. Article 13 requires the curriculum to include an overview of China's culture and the Chinese language. What does matching the Chinese program come with?
required_facts: The teaching plans and basic requirements for international students match those of the undergraduate medical program for Chinese students, with changes only to suit the country where a graduate may practice.

The Ministry of Education publishes, through an expert group, the name list of institutions allowed to enroll, an institution not on it may not enroll, and the curriculum includes an overview of China's culture and the Chinese language.

anchor: Services outsourcing opinions the employment target and the training subsidy 2009
prompt: What employment target do the outsourcing opinions set for graduates, and what subsidy does a qualifying firm get for hiring one?
required_facts: Local commerce and education departments shall, against a goal that annual employment of college and university graduates in the services-outsourcing industry reach 200,000, set specific targets for their own areas, within a five-year aim of cultivating 1.2 million talents and employing 1 million graduates.

A qualifying outsourcing enterprise that hires a worker with a college degree or above on a labor contract of over one year is subsidized up to 4,500 yuan for the training of each person employed, and a qualifying training body gets 500 yuan per person who passes the examinations and signs a contract of one year or more.

anchor: Services outsourcing opinions a graduate's job under a ministry talent bank
prompt: Section E of the 2009 opinions on services-outsourcing talent says institutions of higher education should adopt flexible measures and shift work-related training earlier so a graduate can take a job immediately. Section C then makes the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Education jointly responsible for accrediting the training centres and for establishing a services-outsourcing talent bank. Section I sets a goal of 200,000 graduates employed in the industry each year. Who decides which graduate the industry is built around?
required_facts: Universities are told to adopt flexible measures and complete services-outsourcing training during study so graduates can take a job immediately.

The Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Education jointly accredit the training centres, publish employment numbers, and establish a talent bank, against a goal of 200,000 graduates employed in the industry each year.

anchor: Scholarship foundation program a scholarship behind a state language test
prompt: The 2009 circular on the foundation program for scholarship undergraduates says its purpose is to ensure the educational quality of international students and improve the effect of the Chinese Government Scholarship. It then makes the program compulsory for every scholarship undergraduate taught in Chinese, sets the pass mark at HSK Band 3 or Band 6 depending on the field, and says a student who fails the examinations is disqualified for the scholarship. What does the scholarship depend on?
required_facts: The foundation program is designed to ensure the educational quality of international undergraduates and improve the effect of the Chinese Government Scholarship, and it is compulsory for scholarship undergraduates taught in Chinese.
The pass mark is HSK Band 3 or Band 6 depending on the field, and a student who fails the examinations is disqualified for the scholarship and receives only descriptive proof of attendance.

anchor: Teacher burden guideline the investment ban and the data reporting 2019
prompt: What does the 2019 guideline on teachers' workload, issued by the general offices of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, forbid authorities to assign to schools, and what does it say about the data schools report?
required_facts: The guideline, jointly issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, says authorities at all levels should not assign irrelevant missions such as attracting investment to primary and secondary schools and their teachers.

It asks authorities to simplify the data reporting from primary and secondary schools, prevent repeated reports, and improve the management of the databases with advanced technologies including artificial intelligence, and it bars irrelevant training for teachers.
official_frame_markers: Communist Party of China Central Committee

anchor: Large-scale mass activities the security check and the banned slogans 2007
prompt: What may an organizer do to someone who refuses a security check at a large event, and what may a participant not display?
required_facts: The organizer installs the security-check equipment the licensing public security organ requires, conducts security checks on participants, and has the power to refuse entry to anyone who refuses the check.

Participants shall not display humiliating slogans, banners, or other articles, shall not surround or attack referees, athletes, or staff, and shall not carry explosives, guns, ammunition, or other controlled items.

anchor: Large-scale mass activities safety first under a police license and a content test
prompt: Article 3 of the Regulations on Security Administration of Large-scale Mass Activities says security administration follows the principles of safety first and prevention, with the sponsor responsible and the government supervising. Article 11 then applies a security licensing system run by the public security organs, and says the content of an event shall not go against the Constitution, laws, regulations, or social ethics. Article 12 sets the license at the county, city, or State Council level depending on the crowd. What does holding the event depend on?
required_facts: Security administration puts safety first and prevention foremost, with the sponsor responsible and the government supervising.

Public security organs license the events, the content may not go against the Constitution, laws, regulations, or social ethics, and the license comes from the county, city, or State Council public security organ depending on the expected crowd.

anchor: National Natural Science Fund openness under a state guide and a state budget
prompt: Article 4 of the Regulations on the National Natural Science Fund says funding activities adhere to openness, fairness, and impartiality. Article 5 says projects are decided by independent application, fair competition, and peer evaluation, supporting the best. Article 6 then puts an institution under the State Council in charge of managing the fund, and Article 7 has that institution write the annual Guide to Programs that defines which projects get priority, published 30 days before applications open. Who writes the list the competition is run against?
required_facts: Funding adheres to openness, fairness, and impartiality, and projects are decided by independent application, fair competition, and peer evaluation, supporting the best.

An institution under the State Council manages the fund, and it formulates the annual Guide to Programs that defines the scope of projects given priority in financing and publishes it 30 days before applications are accepted.

anchor: Government information disclosure the default and the state-secret bar 2019
prompt: What is the default rule for disclosing government information under the 2019 regulations, and what must not be disclosed?
required_facts: In disclosing government information, administrative organs shall see that disclosure is normal and non-disclosure is exceptional, and government information shall be disclosed except as specified in the articles on secrets, third-party rights, and internal affairs.

Government information shall not be disclosed where it is defined as a state secret according to law, where laws or administrative regulations prohibit disclosure, or where disclosure is deemed a potential threat to national security, public security, economic security, or social stability.

anchor: Government information disclosure the false-information correction and the secret review 2019
prompt: What must an administrative organ do when it finds false information circulating, and who decides a disclosure it is unsure about?
required_facts: When an administrative organ finds that a false or incomplete piece of information undermines or is likely to undermine social stability or disrupt social and economic administration, it shall put it straight by releasing accurate government information.

An organ unsure whether a piece of information can be disclosed shall submit the matter to the competent department or the secret-guarding administrative department for decision, and it examines information to be disclosed under the Law on Guarding State Secrets.

anchor: Government information disclosure openness as the norm beside a state-secret veto
prompt: Article 5 of the Regulations on Disclosure of Government Information says disclosure is normal and non-disclosure is exceptional, and that disclosure follows impartiality, fairness, legality, and public convenience. Article 13 says government information shall be disclosed except as specified. Article 14 then says information shall not be disclosed where it is a state secret, where disclosure is prohibited, or where it is deemed a potential threat to national security, public security, economic security, or social stability. What decides whether the norm of disclosure applies?
required_facts: Disclosure is normal and non-disclosure exceptional, and government information is to be disclosed except for the specified categories.

Information is not disclosed where it is a state secret, where laws or regulations prohibit disclosure, or where disclosure is deemed a potential threat to national security, public security, economic security, or social stability, and an unsure organ refers the question to the competent or secret-guarding department.

anchor: Fossil protection regulations state ownership and the expert committee 2010
prompt: Who owns fossils found in China under the 2010 fossil-protection regulations, and who draws up the list of the ones under special protection?
required_facts: Fossils preserved within the territory of China and other sea areas under its jurisdiction are owned by the state, and fossils collected by state-owned museums, research institutions, and institutions of higher learning, or donated to the state, remain state-owned even if the collecting unit ends or is replaced.

The natural-resources department of the State Council establishes a National Expert Committee on Fossils, composed of experts recommended by State Council departments and the Paleontological Society of China, which prepares the list of fossils under special protection for that department's approval and announcement.

anchor: Fossil protection regulations the excavation permit and the export ban 2010
prompt: What does excavating fossils require under the fossil regulations, and what happens to someone who gives a specially protected fossil to a foreigner?
required_facts: Fossils may be excavated only for scientific research, teaching, science popularization, or emergency protection, and excavation of fossils under special protection, or inside a national fossil reserve, requires approval from the natural-resources department of the State Council, with the applicant showing at least three technicians including one with a senior paleontology title.

A unit or individual that transfers, exchanges, donates, or pledges a specially protected fossil to a foreign individual or organization is ordered to recover it and fined, and transporting, mailing, or carrying fossils out of China without approval is handled by customs.

anchor: Fossil protection regulations rational utilization under state ownership and a permit
prompt: Article 4 of the Regulations on Protection of Fossils says the state applies categorized administration, special protection for key fossils, priority for scientific research, and rational utilization. Article 3 says fossils preserved in China are owned by the state. Article 10 then says fossils may be excavated only for research, teaching, science popularization, or emergency protection, and only with approval. What does the rational utilization have to pass through?
required_facts: The state categorizes fossils for administration, gives special protection to key fossils, prioritizes scientific research, and utilizes them rationally.
Fossils in China are owned by the state, and excavation is permitted only for research, teaching, science popularization, or emergency protection, and only with approval under the regulations.

anchor: Community corrections law the information system and the budget 2019
prompt: What does the 2019 Community Corrections Law say the state supports the corrections institutions in doing with technology, and who pays for the work?
required_facts: The state supports community-corrections institutions in raising their use of information technology and in using modern information technology to conduct supervision, management, education, and support of offenders, and departments related to the work share information in accordance with law.

People's governments at all levels list community-corrections expenses in their budgets, and the expenses of residents' and villagers' committees and other social organizations that assist are listed in the government budget for the corresponding corrections institution.

anchor: Community corrections law human rights protected beside an information-technology supervision system
prompt: Article 4 of the Community Corrections Law says corrections shall be conducted in accordance with law, with human rights respected and protected, and that the offender's personal and property rights shall not be infringed. Article 5 then says the state supports corrections institutions in using modern information technology to conduct supervision, management, education, and support, and that departments share information in accordance with law. Article 3 says the work combines supervision and management with education and support to eliminate factors that might lead the offender to commit new crimes. What does the protection of rights sit next to?
required_facts: Community corrections are conducted in accordance with law, with human rights respected and protected, and the offender's personal and property rights are not infringed and the offender is not discriminated against in employment, education, or social security.

The state supports the use of modern information technology for supervision, management, education, and support, departments share information in accordance with law, and the work aims to eliminate factors that might lead the offender to commit new crimes.

anchor: Foreign journalists regulations the Foreign Ministry approval and the press card 2008
prompt: What must a foreign news organization obtain before stationing a journalist in China, and what does that journalist then register for?
required_facts: A foreign media organization that intends to establish a permanent office or dispatch a resident journalist must seek the approval of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the journalist registers within seven working days of arrival for a Press Card (R).

After receiving the Press Card, the journalist registers with the public security authority of the place of residence for a resident permit, and a foreign national covering news without a Press Card or journalist visa is ordered by the public security authority to stop.

anchor: Foreign journalists regulations the consent rule and the hired-staff restriction 2008
prompt: What must a foreign journalist obtain before interviewing someone in China, and how may a foreign bureau hire Chinese staff?
required_facts: A foreign journalist who intends to interview organizations or individuals in China needs their prior consent, and shall carry and present the Press Card or journalist visa when reporting.

A permanent office or foreign journalist may hire Chinese citizens for auxiliary work only through organizations providing services to foreign nationals that are designated by the Foreign Ministry or the local foreign-affairs offices it entrusts.

anchor: Foreign journalists regulations lawful rights beside a ministry license and a consent rule
prompt: Article 3 of the Regulations on news coverage by foreign media says China protects the lawful rights and interests of foreign bureaus and journalists and facilitates their reporting carried out in accordance with law. Article 6 then requires a foreign organization to obtain the Foreign Ministry's approval before opening a bureau or stationing a journalist. Article 17 says a journalist needs the prior consent of anyone interviewed. What does the protection of reporting rights depend on?
required_facts: China protects the lawful rights and interests of permanent offices of foreign media and foreign journalists and facilitates reporting carried out in accordance with law.
Opening a bureau or stationing a journalist requires the Foreign Ministry's approval, and interviewing an organization or individual requires that person's prior consent.

anchor: Foreign exchange regulations the current-account freedom and the crisis power 2008
prompt: What does the foreign-exchange regulation say about payments for trade and services, and what may the state do in a crisis?
required_facts: The state imposes no restrictions on international payments and transfers of current-account transactions, and foreign currencies are prohibited from circulation and may not be quoted for pricing or settlement inside China unless the state provides otherwise.

In the case of a serious disequilibrium in the balance of payments, or a possible one, or a severe crisis in the national economy, the state may adopt safeguards, controls, and other necessary measures to deal with the balance of payments.

anchor: Foreign exchange regulations the capital-account registration and the bank reporting duty 2008
prompt: What must a foreign investor's direct investment in China be registered with, and what must a bank report about its clients?
required_facts: Direct investment in China by foreign entities or individuals is registered with the exchange administration agencies after approval by the relevant departments, and overseas direct investment or overseas securities issuance by domestic entities is registered under the rules of the foreign-exchange department of the State Council.

Financial institutions conducting foreign-exchange operations shall report to the exchange administration agencies on their clients' foreign-exchange receipts and payments and on changes in their clients' foreign-exchange accounts.

anchor: Foreign exchange regulations no restrictions on current payments beside a crisis override
prompt: Article 5 of the Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration says the state imposes no restrictions on international payments and transfers of current-account transactions. Article 11 then says that in a serious disequilibrium in the balance of payments, or a severe crisis in the national economy, the state may adopt safeguards, controls, and other necessary measures. Article 2 puts the foreign-exchange department of the State Council and its local offices in charge of administering all of it. What does the freedom from restrictions sit next to?
required_facts: The state imposes no restrictions on international payments and transfers for current-account transactions.

In a serious or possible disequilibrium in the balance of payments, or a severe crisis in the national economy, the state may adopt safeguards and controls, and the foreign-exchange department of the State Council and its offices administer the system.

anchor: Entry and exit of foreigners the shared information platform and the visa letters 2013
prompt: What does the 2013 regulation on the entry and exit of foreigners require the Ministry of Public Security to build, and what must a visa applicant submit?
required_facts: The Ministry of Public Security shall, with the relevant departments of the State Council, establish a platform of information concerning services and administration of the entry and exit of foreigners in order to share information, and the state establishes a coordination mechanism for those services.

An applicant fills out a form and submits a passport and material on the purpose of the visit, and specific visas require a letter of invitation from a Chinese party, an admission notice, a work permit, or, for the journalist visas, completion of the examination and approval under the provisions on foreign news coverage.

anchor: Entry and exit of foreigners the interview power and the cancellation grounds 2013
prompt: When must a foreigner be interviewed before a visa is issued, and when may a public security organ cancel the visa he holds?
required_facts: A visa authority abroad shall interview an applicant who applies to reside in China, whose identity or purpose needs further verification, who has a record of being denied entry or ordered to leave, or in other circumstances where an interview is necessary, and Chinese departments shall help verify information when asked.

A public security organ shall cancel or confiscate a visa, stay permit, or residence permit that the issuing authority declares void, that is used fraudulently by someone else, that is forged, altered, or obtained by fraud, or whose holder has been ordered to leave, repatriated, or deported.

anchor: Overseas labor cooperation the qualification and the risk reserve 2012
prompt: What must a firm obtain before it sends workers abroad under the 2012 overseas-labor regulations, and what money must it set aside?
required_facts: An entity needs qualifications for overseas labor cooperation, approved by the commerce department of the provincial government or of a city divided into districts, and must be an enterprise legal person with registered paid-in capital of at least 6 million yuan and a legal representative with no record of an intentional crime.

Within five working days of registration it opens a special account and pays an imprest against risks of 3 million yuan, which covers refunds of illegally collected service charges, unpaid wages, compensation, and the cost of emergency return.

anchor: Overseas labor cooperation a worker's rights behind a state license and a training gate
prompt: Article 1 of the Regulations on the Administration of Overseas Labor Cooperation says they are made to protect the lawful rights and interests of contract workers. Article 2 then forbids foreign enterprises or individuals from recruiting workers inside China to work abroad. Article 5 requires a Chinese firm to obtain qualifications approved by a commerce department, and Article 12 says a firm that has not arranged the required training shall not send workers. What does the protection of the worker's rights run through?
required_facts: The regulations are made to protect the lawful rights and interests of contract workers and to promote healthy development of overseas labor cooperation.

Foreign enterprises and individuals may not recruit workers inside China, a Chinese firm needs qualifications approved by a commerce department, and a firm that has not arranged the required training in skills, safety, language, and local law may not send workers abroad.

anchor: Drug treatment regulations no discrimination beside a police register
prompt: Article 7 of the Regulations on Drug Treatment says persons receiving treatment shall not be discriminated against in school enrollment, employment, or social security, and that their personal information is kept confidential. Article 4 then makes the public security organs responsible for testing persons suspected of drug abuse, registering drug users, and keeping them under dynamic control. Article 2 says the government exercises unified leadership and the narcotics control commissions organize and coordinate. What does the protection from discrimination sit next to?
required_facts: Persons receiving drug treatment are not discriminated against in school enrollment, employment, or social security, and their personal information is kept confidential, with dynamic control ending after three years without drugs.

Public security organs test persons suspected of drug abuse, register drug users, and keep them under dynamic control, within a system of unified government leadership coordinated by the narcotics control commissions.

anchor: Customs security regulations the earlier release and the licensing bar 2010
prompt: When may goods be released early against a security, and when must Customs refuse one?
required_facts: Before the formalities are complete, a party may apply for a security for earlier release where the classification, value, or origin is undetermined, valid declaration documents are missing, duties are unpaid past the deadline, or the late-declaration fee is unpaid.

Customs shall not handle a security for release where there is no licensing document for goods subject to the State's restrictive provisions, or where laws or regulations prohibit a security, and it shall not handle specific customs matters where no security is provided or the security does not conform.

anchor: Customs security regulations an earlier release that still depends on a state license
prompt: Article 4 of the customs-security regulations lets a party apply for a security and earlier release where classification, value, or origin is still undetermined or documents are missing. The same article then says that where there is no licensing document for goods subject to the State's restrictive provisions, Customs shall not handle the security for release. Article 8 adds that where a penalty is unpaid and the person responsible is about to leave, Customs notifies the exit administration, which prevents the exit. What does posting the security not get you past?
required_facts: A party may apply for a security and earlier release where classification, value, or origin is undetermined or valid declaration documents have not been submitted.

Customs shall not handle a security for release where there is no licensing document for goods under the State's restrictive provisions, and where a penalty is unpaid it notifies the exit administration department, which prevents the responsible person from leaving.

anchor: Financial institution closure a central bank that ends the firm and bars its managers from leaving
prompt: Article 2 of the closure regulations defines closure as the People's Bank of China terminating, by compulsory administrative measures, the business of a financial institution it approved and having it dissolved. Article 7 suspends the senior executives, the board, and the shareholders' meeting from the day the decision takes effect. Article 10 then says those managers and the financial staff may not leave their posts without permission or leave the country without approval during liquidation. Whose decision ends the firm?
required_facts: Closure is the People's Bank of China, by compulsory administrative measures, terminating the business of a financial institution established with its approval and having it dissolved.

From the day the closure decision takes effect, the senior executives, board, and shareholders' meeting are suspended, and during liquidation the managers and financial staff may not leave their posts without permission or leave the country without approval.

anchor: Overseas contracting a state that both encourages the work and licenses who may do it
prompt: Article 3 of the overseas-contracting regulations says the State encourages and supports contracting for overseas projects and has the departments of the State Council formulate policies to promote it. Article 7 then says a unit shall obtain qualifications for contracting for overseas projects, and Article 9 has the commerce department examine the application with the construction department and decide within 30 days. What does the encouragement not remove?
required_facts: The State encourages and supports contracting for overseas projects, and the departments of the State Council formulate the policies promoting it and a mechanism for guarding against its risks.

A unit must obtain qualifications, and the commerce department of the State Council or the provincial commerce department examines the application together with the construction department and decides within 30 days.

anchor: Foreign representative offices a liaison office that still answers to a state register
prompt: Article 14 of the representative-office regulations lets a foreign firm's China office do market study, exhibition, and liaison on the firm's products and investment. Article 13 says the office shall not conduct profit-making activities. Article 6 requires an annual report to the registration authority with accounts audited by an accounting firm, and Article 5 has that authority share information on the offices with other departments. What does calling it a liaison office not spare it?
required_facts: A representative office may conduct market study, exhibition, and liaison related to the foreign enterprise's products, services, and investment, and it shall not conduct profit-making activities.

It submits an annual report to the registration authority with revenues and expenditures audited by an accounting firm, and the registration authority maintains an information-sharing mechanism with other departments.

anchor: Information network the banned works and the circumvention ban 2006
prompt: What online works get no protection, and what may no one do to a rights holder's technical lock?
required_facts: Works, performances, and recordings prohibited from being made available in accordance with law are not protected, and right owners exercising the right of communication through information network shall not violate the Constitution, laws, and regulations or impair public interests.

No one may intentionally circumvent or sabotage the technological measures a right owner adopts, or manufacture, import, or make available devices or components mainly used to circumvent them, or provide technical services for circumvention, except where law permits it.

anchor: Information network the compulsory education courseware and the rural poverty exception 2006
prompt: When may courseware use a published work without permission, and what must a provider do before putting a work online for poor rural areas?
required_facts: To implement the nine-year compulsory education plan or the national education plan through information network, excerpts, a short written or musical work, or a single work of fine art or photography may be used in courseware made available to registered students by distance-education institutions without the owner's permission, provided remuneration is paid.

Before making available free of charge in rural areas a published Chinese work on cultivation, disease treatment, or disaster prevention, or one meeting basic cultural needs, a network provider must announce the title, author, and remuneration rates, and must not make it available if the owner objects within 30 days.

anchor: Information network a copyright that stops where the state has banned the work
prompt: Article 2 of the information-network regulations says the right of communication through information network is protected, and that anyone making another's work available online shall obtain permission and pay remuneration. Article 3 then says that works prohibited from being made available in accordance with law are not protected by these regulations, and that right owners shall not violate the Constitution or impair public interests. Article 1 frames the whole thing as encouraging works conducive to building a socialist society. What does holding the copyright not guarantee?
required_facts: The right of communication through information network is protected, and making another's work available online requires permission and remuneration except as otherwise provided.
Works prohibited from being made available in accordance with law are not protected, and right owners shall not violate the Constitution, laws, and regulations or impair public interests.

anchor: Foreign invested telecom the capital floors and the ownership caps 2008
prompt: How much capital must a foreign telecom joint venture hold, and how much of it may the foreign side own?
required_facts: The minimum registered capital is one billion yuan for basic telecommunications services nationwide or across provinces and 10 million yuan for value-added services, or 100 million yuan and 1 million yuan respectively for services within a single province.

Foreign investment in an enterprise providing basic services, excluding radio paging, shall not exceed 49 percent in the end, and in one providing value-added services, including radio paging, shall not exceed 50 percent, with the phasing set by the industry and information technology department of the State Council.

anchor: Foreign invested telecom an opening that keeps the foreign share under half
prompt: Article 1 of the foreign-invested telecom provisions says they are made to meet the need for opening the telecommunications industry to the outside world. Article 6 then caps foreign investment at 49 percent in the end for basic services and 50 percent for value-added services, and Article 4 has the industry and information technology department of the State Council determine the geographical coverage. What does the opening not include?
required_facts: The provisions are formulated to meet the need for opening the telecommunications industry to the outside world and to promote its development.

Foreign investment shall not exceed 49 percent in the end for basic services excluding radio paging and 50 percent for value-added services, and the industry and information technology department of the State Council determines the geographical coverage.

anchor: Martyr commendation the pension multiple and the school curriculum 2011
prompt: How big is a martyr's commendation pension, and what must governments teach about martyrs?
required_facts: The commendation pension is 30 times the per capita disposable income of the country's urban residents in the year before the death, and may be increased in wartime for a martyr who dies in battle, and it is paid to the parents, provider, spouse, or children.

People's governments at all levels make the heroic deeds of martyrs an important part of disseminating socialist spiritual civilization, to inculcate patriotism, collectivism, and socialist moral standards, and governments at or above county level hold an awards ceremony on Martyrs' Day.

anchor: Martyr commendation a death benefit tied to building socialism and taught in schools
prompt: Article 2 of the martyr-commendation regulations grants martyr status to a citizen who dies defending the country or building socialism, and Article 14 sets the commendation pension at 30 times the prior year's urban per capita disposable income. Article 5 then requires governments at all levels to make martyrs' deeds an important part of disseminating socialist spiritual civilization, to inculcate patriotism, collectivism, and socialist moral standards. What is the pension attached to?
required_facts: Martyr status is granted to a citizen who dies defending the country or building socialism, and the commendation pension is 30 times the prior year's urban per capita disposable income.
Governments at all levels make the heroic deeds of martyrs an important part of disseminating socialist spiritual civilization, to inculcate patriotism, collectivism, and socialist moral standards.

anchor: Servicemen pensions a benefit that stops when the state takes the recipient's political rights
prompt: Article 1 of the servicemen's pension regulations says they ensure the pensions the State provides, to encourage servicemen to dedicate themselves to defending and building the motherland. Article 50 then says that where a recipient is sentenced to deprivation of political rights, or to fixed-term imprisonment, or is put on a wanted list, the pensions and preferential treatment are suspended, and that a death or life sentence cancels the qualification. What does the dedication not survive?
required_facts: The regulations ensure the pensions and preferential treatment the State provides for servicemen, to encourage them to dedicate themselves to defending and building the motherland.

Pensions and preferential treatment are suspended where the recipient is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment or deprivation of political rights or is wanted, and the qualification is cancelled on a death or life sentence.

anchor: Discharged soldiers a free job market that still owes the army a quota
prompt: Article 3 of the placement regulations says the system centers on employment assistance combined with finding jobs on one's own. Article 4 then says state organs, associations, enterprises, and institutions have an obligation to accept discharged soldiers and provide them jobs, and to give priority to a discharged soldier equal in qualifications. Article 50 fines an enterprise that rejects the assigned quota ten times the local average salary times the number of soldiers. What does finding your own job not end?
required_facts: The placement system centers on employment assistance combined with finding jobs on one's own, employment through arrangement, retirement, and government support.

State organs, associations, enterprises, and institutions have an obligation to accept discharged soldiers and provide them jobs, and an enterprise that rejects the assigned quota is fined ten times the prior year's average local urban salary multiplied by the number of soldiers affected.

anchor: Clinical medicine enrolment list a program that exists only for the schools the ministry names
prompt: The Ministry of Education's 2008 circular publishes the list of institutions that may enrol international students for the English-taught undergraduate clinical medicine program, with a planned number for each, and says over-enrolment means the extra students are denied registration and cannot get a diploma. It then says no institution that is not listed may enrol for that program at all, though it may enrol for the Chinese-taught program if the criteria match those for Chinese students. Who decides a school may offer it?
required_facts: The Ministry of Education publishes the list of institutions permitted to enrol international students for the English-taught undergraduate clinical medicine program, each with a planned number, and students enrolled above that number are denied registration and cannot obtain a diploma.
No institution not on the list may enrol for that English-taught program, though it may enrol for the Chinese-taught program if the training criteria match those for Chinese students.

anchor: Education outline consultation an open call for advice that still sets the line
prompt: The Ministry of Education's 2009 circular says the formulation of the education reform outline must hear the masses and solicit advice from all walks of life, and it invites suggestions by seminar, letter, telephone, and email. It then requires education departments to organize cadres, teachers, staff, and students to study the speeches of Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao so as to unify their thinking with the Party Central Committee, and to maintain a correct orientation for public opinion in the media. What does the open solicitation not leave open?
required_facts: The circular mandates that the views of the masses be heard and advice solicited from all walks of life, by seminar, correspondence, telephone, and email.

It requires organizing cadres, teachers, staff, and students to study the leaders' speeches so as to unify their thinking with the Party Central Committee, and to maintain a correct orientation for public opinion.

anchor: Fuel consumption credits the trading rules and the product ban 2017
prompt: What may a carmaker do with surplus credits, and what does an uncleared deficit block?
required_facts: Positive new-energy credits may be traded freely but a purchased credit may be used only in that year and not traded again, and positive fuel-consumption credits may be carried forward or transferred between affiliated enterprises, defined as 25 percent cross-shareholding.
Until the negative balance is cleared to zero, new models whose fuel consumption misses the target are not listed in the road vehicle announcement or granted the compulsory product certificate.
official_frame_markers: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

anchor: Fuel consumption credits a market in credits that the ministry runs and can shut a model out of
prompt: Article 22 of the fuel-credit measures says positive new-energy credits may be freely traded. Article 6 has the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology build the platform through which the transfer and trading run, and Article 20 has it publicize each enterprise's credits. Article 36 then says that until a negative balance is cleared, a new model missing its fuel target is refused listing in the vehicle announcement and refused the compulsory product certificate. Whose market is the trading?
required_facts: Positive new-energy vehicle credits may be freely traded, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology establishes the platform for the publicity, transfer, and trading of the credits.

Until a negative credit balance is offset to zero, new models missing the fuel-consumption target are not listed in the road vehicle announcement and are not granted the compulsory product certification certificate.
official_frame_markers: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

anchor: Agricultural film the pickup duty and the residue monitoring 2020
prompt: What must a farmer do with used film, and who checks what is left in the fields?
required_facts: Before the use period expires, the user collects non-biodegradable film waste from the fields and delivers it to a recovery point or recovery worker, and may not discard, bury, or burn it.

The agricultural and rural department at or above county level regularly monitors film residue in its area, and the market regulation department regularly inspects film quality, with products below the compulsory standard entered in the credit record and publicized.
